== Of Killers and Kings ==
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">2</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[broad-spectrum augmentation elixir]] turns a person into a [[Champion]] for a few hours with limited capabilities and inconvenient restrictions.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[broad-spectrum augmentation elixir]] makes a user faster, stronger, and harder to kill for a few hours at the expense of feverish flu-like symptoms for several days afterward.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
